sections.title: Recorded sales and refunds
sections.sql: select i.sku,s.reference,s.sold_on,l.currency,s.net_cents,s.consignor_cents,s.refunded_on from sales s join items i on i.id=s.item_id join consignors c on c.id=i.consignor_id join locations l on l.id=c.location_id where c.id=$1 order by s.sold_on

sections.title: Recorded payouts
sections.sql: select p.reference,p.paid_on,l.currency,p.amount_cents,p.actor from settlements p join consignors c on c.id=p.consignor_id join locations l on l.id=c.location_id where c.id=$1 order by paid_on

sections.title: Item and agreed share
sections.note: This records agreed terms. Keep the signed agreement and required dealer records separately.

sections.title: Collection or agreed disposal decision
sections.sql: select sku,title,expires_on,donation_allowed from items where consignor_id=$1 and status='available' and expires_on<=current_date+14 order by expires_on
sections.note: Draft only. Confirm the agreement and record the owner decision before disposal.

name: disposal-record
title: Return or donation record
for_each: select id,sku from items where status in ('returned','donated')

sections.title: Recorded disposal
sections.sql: select sku,title,consignor,status,disposed_on from stock where id=$1

sections.title: Operator notes
sections.sql: select actor,note,created_at from events where item_id=$1 order by created_at
